description: List the character cards available on disk (UserData/chara/female and UserData/chara/male). Returns paths usable as-is with studio_create_character. The first call reads every card once (Studio does the same when it builds its own list) and the result is cached, so subsequent calls are instant.

sex.description: restrict to one folder; omit to list both

query.description: case-insensitive substring matched against the character's full name and the card path

path.description: path relative to UserData/chara, always prefixed with 'female/' or 'male/' — pass this to studio_create_character as 'card'

name.description: full name stored in the card
